lesson: For a Hecke eigenform with a product formula, both the sum and the product of the values at the isogenous points are dilation-module quantities on the arc, so any read built from the mean and the norm is a pointwise function of dilates. Epstein forms pass such reads prime by prime at inert primes; the discriminant sign is a parity count.
